The profile describes no real chip, so the core count is a study axis: 1000, the count of the framework default grid (config_schema/defaults.py, DEFAULT_PLATFORM_CONSTRAINTS), which every ladder and Figure 1 point declares through target_overrides with a note.

faithfulness.note: Every constant of the profile is an estimate and the geometry is an assumption of the profile: the bundle exercises the estimated-evidence path and is never cited as a chip.

notes: allow_coalescing and allow_neuron_splitting are true, an assumption of the estimated point like its geometry: the profile describes no real chip, and its digital cores are assumed to add partial sums and split outputs across cores, as the framework's study grid declares (every tier-0 cell of that grid declares both); a study that assumes otherwise declares either through target_overrides with a note.
